title: Week 9 Cheat Sheet: Intro to Deep RL

items.label: MDP
items.note: $(S,A,r,p,\rho,\gamma)$; policy $\pi(a|s)$; trajectory $\tau=(s_0,a_0,r_0,s_1,\dots)$; actions affect next states and future rewards.

items.label: Return
items.note: Discounted sum of rewards; γ keeps cyclic sums finite and can change the optimal policy.

items.label: Value functions
items.note: $V$ rates a state, $Q$ rates a state–action pair (then follow π).

items.label: Tabular Q-learning
items.note: Off-policy; all pairs must keep being updated (ε-greedy).

items.label: SARSA
items.note: On-policy: uses the action actually chosen next.

items.label: Deep Q-learning
items.note: Target network $\varphi'$ for a fixed target; $d$ = terminal flag; MSBE.

items.label: Policy network (DDPG)
items.note: Actor ascends the critic: $\theta\leftarrow\theta+\alpha\nabla_\theta\frac1{|B|}\sum Q_\varphi(s,\mu_\theta(s))$; replay buffer; Polyak targets.

items.label: Overestimation
items.note: Max over noisy Q is biased upward; fixes: TD3, SAC, Maxmin Q-learning, REDQ.
